canonical_definition: The continuing causal process by which a goal, driven by events, is repeatedly compiled against the current world into executable structure, executed, verified, and committed.
not_to_be_confused_with: A single run, a fixed workflow, a message stream, or a graph.

canonical_definition: The engineering of work in motion: formation, continuity, integrity, adaptation, commitment, closure, and learning.
not_to_be_confused_with: Prompt chaining or workflow orchestration alone.

canonical_definition: A work-centered reference runtime and mechanism kit for agentic software engineering.
The stable, addressable projection of a Flow, carrying identity, state, history, conditions, obligations, findings, effects, and future; can split, merge, or be superseded.
not_to_be_confused_with: A ticket title, one agent session, or the deeper system of record itself.

canonical_definition: One bounded attempt by an agent or deterministic executor on behalf of a Work object.
The environment, tools, context, policies, state, and feedback that make one execution unit capable.
One execution unit unfolding through feedback over time.
A versioned structural projection of execution units and dependencies for a given work state.
A graph derived at a specific fact watermark and work state.
A bounded, provenance-bound local execution view compiled from current authoritative state.
not_to_be_confused_with: A handoff summary or chat history dump.

canonical_definition: Invalidation localization, impact propagation, and partial recompilation of future work.
A persistent, evidence-bound statement that something is wrong, unknown, or unverified.
A condition that must be satisfied before a governed transition may occur.
The goals, ontology, judgments, obligations, authority, red lines, acceptance, and evolution rules owned by humans.
The accumulated executable structure of a person or organization’s judgments, concepts, obligations, skills, validators, and failure learning.
Evidence that an integrated capability was organically invoked in the target environment.
not_to_be_confused_with: A test, demo, drill, or mere deployment.

canonical_definition: A binding judgment by the responsible owner that the required outcome is acceptable.
An empirical and replayable collection of structural agent-system failures, mechanisms, and remaining boundaries.
